parsed.rationale: The tracing shows QS complexes in V1–V3 with no R-wave progression, which points to an anterior (anteroseptal) infarct, along with left axis deviation, rS in II and QS in III/aVF; on this image I can't see ST elevation reaching STEMI thresholds (≥2 mm in V2–V3 or ≥1 mm in two contiguous leads), so the infarct may not be acute or the ST changes may be subtle or have evolved, and serial ECGs and troponin would settle it.
